# Think CBT

> UK-wide network of 200+ BABCP-accredited CBT specialists and EMDR practitioners offering online and face-to-face cognitive behavioural therapy for anxiety, depression, trauma, and relationship issues.

Think CBT provides evidence-based psychological therapy services across the UK with specialized offerings for children, adolescents, couples, men, and women. The practice combines traditional CBT with NICE-recommended EMDR treatment and maintains partnerships with major insurers including Aviva and AXA.

## Key Topics

- BABCP-accredited
- Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT)
- EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing)
- Online therapy
- Anxiety and depression treatment
- Trauma therapy
- Couples therapy
- Children and adolescent CBT
- Men's mental health
- Women's mental health
- Sevenoaks
- London
- UK-wide services
- Mental health treatment
- Therapist directory

## Core Services

- [Homepage](https://thinkcbt.com): Main hub for Think CBT, UK-wide BABCP-accredited CBT specialists offering online and face-to-face therapy.
- [Online CBT](https://thinkcbt.com/online-cbt): Remote CBT services via Zoom, Skype, Teams, and WebEx with BABCP-accredited therapists.
- [EMDR Therapy](https://thinkcbt.com/eye-movement-desensitisation-and-reprocessing-emdr-sevenoaks-london): NICE-recommended EMDR therapy for trauma and PTSD available online and in London and Sevenoaks locations.

## Specialized Therapy Programs

- [Child & Adolescent CBT](https://thinkcbt.com/child-adolescent-cbt): CBT services for children and teenagers in Sevenoaks, available online and face-to-face.
- [Couples & Relationship Counselling](https://thinkcbt.com/cbt-couples-relationship-problems): Couples CBT and relationship counselling in Sevenoaks and London locations.
- [CBT for Men](https://thinkcbt.com/mens-cbt): Specialized CBT and counselling services addressing men's mental health issues.
- [CBT for Women](https://thinkcbt.com/womens-cbt): Women-focused CBT services in Sevenoaks, London, and UK-wide locations.

## Locations

- [London](http://www.thinkcbt.com/london): BABCP-accredited CBT services in London for anxiety, depression, and stress management.
